name: KAISER 8 GC

specs.notes: All from BMW's M8 Competition Coupe spec sheet (03/2021): 625 PS (460 kW) at 6,000 rpm, 750 Nm from 1,800 to 5,860 rpm, 1,900 kg DIN unladen (EU 1,975 kg), the 8-speed's ratios with a 3.154 final drive, 2,827 mm wheelbase, 250 km/h limited (305 with the M Driver's Package). M xDrive is rear-biased and fully variable, with no fixed split published; the game uses 30 % front. No weight distribution or drag figure was published: 53 % front and Cd 0.33 on 2.25 m^2 are estimates.

garage.blurb: BMW's big grand tourer in Competition trim: a 625 PS twin-turbo V8, four-wheel drive that can go rear-only, and a carbon roof. Long legs, short fuse.

interior.notes: The model's: dash, seats, the M wheel (its own parts); left-hand drive. An automatic: the hands stay on the wheel.

limitations: Weight distribution, drag and M xDrive's split are estimates.
The source is a game mod holding several body kits at once (stock, Competition, CS, Keyvany, Manhart) and trim colours: the stock Competition set is kept, the rest dropped.
